scope: Source only. Local pfl-pg-test diagnostics on synthetic ~23KB toasted jsonb rows (5081 rows); not hosted p95, not a deployment.
finding: list_all_selected referenced the raw wide payload column twice per row (jsonb_typeof type check, then payload || '{}'), detoasting every row twice in the facts scan. Removing the copy entirely is slower (each fact expression detoasts again), consistent with the actual EXPLAIN (321ms of 369ms in facts scan).
change: services/foundation/postgres_json_store.py: payload || '{}' is computed once as the detoasted value; the raw column is re-read only when that result is an array (legacy string-encoded payload or a real array), so object rows detoast once. Same row set, ordering, legacy-string unwrapping, visible-then-family snapshot semantics.
regression: services/registry/test_owner_durability.py::test_list_all_selected_detoasts_wide_payload_once_and_keeps_payload_shapes (block hits; fails on old, passes on new; also covers legacy string/array/scalar payload shapes)
unchanged: BFF request path, default full strategy API, family/visibility semantics, no cache/migration/fallback.
